messages:
sam: FYI vendor just bumped the H200 delivery window. New estimate 9-11 weeks due to port congestion + new customs QA. Need a quick mitigation plan (alloc shuffle / loaners / expedite). @lisa_vendor, can you share AWB(s) and whether depot-level serial pre-validation is possible?
lisa_vendor: Apologies for the shift. We're seeing a hold at the gateway for a subset of containers. Proposal: split into a small acceptance batch (AWB: NXS-9001123) next Tue for QA and the rest in follow-up. Normal transit 9-11w; we can offer an expedited airlift (carrier: SkySprint) to get units in 3-5w but it's +$3.5k/unit and subject to runway slots. We can add a 6% outbound buffer for DOA on this SKU. Depot for RMAs: FRA-depot (depot-contact@lisa-logistics.com), expects serial manifest on arrival.
raj: Can vendor confirm warranty handling for buffer units? Are buffer units billed as consumed or invoiced as returnable until consumed? Also what's historical DOA on H200? We saw 2.3% last quarter which would push buffer need higher.
lisa_vendor: Historical DOA reported at 1.6% for H200 across last 6 months; our 6% buffer is conservative. Billing model options: (A) bill all shipped now and credit returns after RMA; (B) ship buffer as consignment, invoice on consumption. Option B requires a short consignment agreement but saves immediate spend.
toni: Short-term infra actions: (1) pull 24 GPUs from nonprod pool for 10 days, (2) enable gpufreq throttling on noncritical jobs to free ~8% headroom, (3) hold on scheduled heavy evals next week. @ops-bot open ticket to track borrow and vendor decision.
ops-bot: Ticket INC-2026-1987 created 1 "H200 port congestion + split ship + RMA buffer decision" assigned infra/ops. Link: https://redwood.internal/INC-2026-1987
kevin: For the runbook check: staging commands to accept provisional units and pre-reconcile serials: ```aws s3 cp s3://shipments/manifest-NXS-9001123.csv /tmp/```
```python tools/serial_reconcile.py --manifest /tmp/manifest-NXS-9001123.csv --depot fra --auto-accept```
We should gate onboarding on serial match >=98%.
raj: If we go with expedite, finance needs a PO amendment and cost-center assignment. Also confirm whether our 30-day price protection clause applies; if not, expedite pricing might not be covered.
lisa_vendor: Price protection applies only to factory list price for 30 days; expedite surcharge is a service fee and falls outside protection. Draft invoice for both normal and expedite flows will be sent by EOD. Provisional ship qty: 10 units. Main batch depends on PO amendment.
sam: Okay. Raj/toni coordinate with finance to decide consignment vs billed buffer. If APAC has spare inventory, can we trade 16 units EU<->APAC? Lisa, can you check cross-region reallocation and additional customs paperwork time?
lisa_vendor: We can reassign from APAC but cross-region re-doc adds ~48-72h and a minor admin fee. Checking APAC pool now, will update in thread.
sam: Good. If expedite cost > threshold, we'll do borrow + consignment buffer and stagger-rollout. We'll update customers and delay nonessential releases. :thumbsup:
